Partner with Customer Success to ensure seamless handoffs from initial demonstration to full implementation, maintaining legal credibility throughout the customer journey.

Shape our go-to-market strategy by analysing litigation market trends, competitor positioning, and emerging use cases where AI can create competitive advantages.

Act as Voice of the legal customer, providing insights into litigation-specific needs and user feedback to inform product development and ensure our platform meets the exacting standards of elite litigators.

Pioneer thought leadership in litigation AI through content creation, speaking engagements, and industry relationship building that positions Wexler as the definitive platform for litigation professionals.




WHAT YOU BRING

You understand that litigation AI isn't just another legal tech tool,  but a fundamental shift in how legal professionals approach their most complex, high-stakes disputes. You thrive on working with brilliant, demanding litigators who expect excellence and have zero tolerance for technology that doesn't deliver results. You're equally comfortable discussing case strategy with KCs as you are explaining AI model performance to litigation teams.

We're looking for:

Qualified lawyer in England & Wales with 1-4 years of litigation experience at a top-tier law firm or specialised litigation boutique. Commercial litigation, international arbitration, or complex dispute resolution experience strongly preferred.

Deep understanding of litigation workflows including document review, fact discovery, case strategy development, and the commercial pressures facing modern litigation practices.

Proven commercial acumen with experience in client development, business development, or strategic consulting. You understand legal procurement processes and can build compelling business cases.

Technical curiosity and learning agility - you can quickly grasp how AI models work, what makes document processing effective, and how to troubleshoot complex legal technology implementations.

Executive presence and communication skills - you can hold your own in partner meetings while also being hands-on with associate teams reviewing millions of documents.

Strategic mindset with ability to identify high-impact use cases, understand competitive dynamics, and translate complex legal requirements into product development insights.

Client-facing experience in professional services, with a track record of building trusted advisor relationships with senior legal stakeholders.

Startup mentality - you're excited by ambiguity, rapid iteration, and the opportunity to build something from the ground up in a category-defining market.

AI enthusiasm - you're genuinely excited about the potential of AI to transform litigation and legal services more broadly.

London-based and office-focused - we work from WeWork Aldwych 4 days per week, and face-to-face collaboration is core to our culture and success.




WHAT WE OFFER

At Wexler, you'll have the unique opportunity to combine your litigation expertise with cutting-edge AI technology, working on truly impactful problems that can determine case outcomes. You'll be part of a fast-scaling, entrepreneurial environment where your legal insights directly shape how we build and position the leading litigation AI platform.

You'll collaborate with our founding team and work at the intersection of law and technology, helping shape how we support legal professionals tackling their most complex disputes. We offer a competitive salary, significant equity in a rapidly growing company, huge autonomy and ownership, budget for learning and professional growth, and bi-annual team retreats.

Ready to revolutionise litigation with AI? Join us in building the Fact Intelligence platform that's changing how cases are won.

jobs.title: Founding Engineer, AI — Shiplight AI
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Founding Engineer, AI — Shiplight AI

  • Do you agree we’re living through the AI revolution?

  • Do you want to be part of it — and run ahead of the curve?

  • Are you ready to help 100x productivity?

If so, join us.

At Shiplight AI, our mission is to build the foundation for enterprise-scale automation powered by intelligent agents. We believe every organization should have AI systems that can understand context, take action, and collaborate seamlessly with humans — transforming how work gets done across the enterprise.

Our first mission: fully automate software quality assurance. We’re building state-of-the-art agentic QA systems that integrate deeply into the software development cycle — empowering every product manager, developer, and tester with their own AI QA engineer that validates work in real time.

You’ll be joining a small, mission-driven founding team led by industry veterans, working at the intersection of AI agents, system engineering, and real-world developer productivity.

What You’ll Do

  • Build core systems that enable AI agents to autonomously test and reason about complex applications.

  • Design, prototype, and ship agentic browser and device automation components.

  • Work directly with the founders to define architecture, roadmap, and company culture.

jobs.title: Founding Growth Development Rep - Spur
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Growth Development Rep

Meet Spur
Spur has made a fundamental change in the testing piece. We help the world's largest brands like Aloyoga, NextDoor, LivingSpaces protect every checkout and every conversion with AI browser agents that simulate shoppers while navigating through the site. The company is backed by top tier VCs like FirstRound Capital, YCombinator, PearVC.

The team

Anuhska, and Sneha the co-founders have a combination of deep technical and product experience (deepmind and figma). Every person on the team punches much above our weight, we are all high leverage operators made up of ex-founders, customers and competitors.(what more could you want). We are a team of thoughtful and resourceful operators.

We’re building AI agents that are changing the game for testing. Moving away from test scripts in code, to natural language based instructions that can tell the agent to just “checkout an item, and make sure the invoice is received in a confirmation email”. Days of work just automated in a single line. This is what we deliver to every customer.

Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Growth Development Rep (GDR) — part SDR, part field marketer, part content creator — to own top-of-funnel growth and bring Spur’s story to life. We have closed the biggest brands from inbound networks built on linkedin and through our customer referrals, and we;re looking for someone to join our sales team to drive up that top of the funnel and bring the company to the next stage of growth.

You’ll generate pipeline through intelligent outbound, creative storytelling, and live event activation. You’ll be the first person many prospects meet — online and in person — and your energy will set the tone for how the world experiences Spur.

Key Responsibilities:

A) Lead Generation & Outbound

  • Research and prioritize high-intent e-commerce and retail brands using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, Apollo, and 6sense.

  • Build multi-touch sequences across email, LinkedIn, and Slack Connect to book high-quality meetings.

  • Qualify leads through discovery calls and hand off to AEs with crisp context.

  • Track outreach and performance in HubSpot / Notion CRM.

B) Event & Conference Activation

  • Partner with marketing on pre-event campaigns for conferences like ShopTalk and NRF.

  • Work our booth, give live demos, and engage attendees with authentic conversation (not scripts).

  • Coordinate pop-up dinners or “live test sessions” with the Spur team.

  • Follow up within 24 hours using personalized Looms and DMs.

Key Impact:

  • Be the engine behind Spur’s growth — turning outreach, content, and events into qualified pipeline.

  • Put Spur in front of every major e-commerce brand that should know us.

  • Directly impact revenue by fueling meetings, demos, and expansion conversations.

🧩 You Might Be a Fit If You…

  • Have 0-2 years of experience in SDR, growth, or creator-led marketing roles.

  • Are comfortable on camera and love storytelling.

  • Write clever, clear outreach messages and actually enjoy the hunt.

  • Thrive in fast-moving startup environments where you can experiment and own results.

  • Care about the future of AI, automation, and how technology shapes commerce.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (AI Solutions) - Atrix
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Atrix, our journey began with a simple belief:
Breakthrough medicines and technologies change lives, and the people making them deserve better tools.

We often celebrate the final moment: a patient receiving a life-saving therapy or a groundbreaking treatment becoming standard of care.
But behind that moment is a complex, coordinated effort that begins years earlier.

Pharmaceutical and med device companies shoulder this responsibility every day:

  • Advancing science from lab to clinic

  • Navigating regulatory and access barriers

  • Ensuring safe, evidence-based adoption in the real world

They’re not just bringing products to market; they’re shaping the future of care.

Yet these organizations are often held back by outdated workflows and siloed data, unable to fully harness the knowledge that already exists across their teams.

Atrix was built to change that.


We exist to support the mission of those who dedicate their lives to creating and delivering innovations that impact global health.

The Role Description

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will sit at the intersection of engineering, implementation, and customer value. You’ll partner directly with enterprise pharma and biotech teams to turn complex scientific workflows into reliable, AI-powered systems that accelerate evidence generation, medical strategy, commercial insights, and patient impact.

You will become the technical owner of several key customer accounts, embedding deeply into their workflows, translating their needs into structured requirements, configuring Atrix’s AI-native platform, and ensuring accuracy, trust, and real-world reliability.

This is one of the most impactful roles at Atrix.

You’ll see your work used daily by medical, clinical, and commercial teams making high-stakes decisions.

You’ll work closely with our Engineering Team and CEO, and collaborate as a peer to product, design, and GTM leadership. As one of our earliest FDEs, you’ll help define technical architecture, influence product strategy, and set the tone for future engineering hires.

💡 This is an hybrid role based in NYC (ability to be in office is required), with flexibility for remote work on some days as needed.

Responsibilities

This role is perfect for someone who is customer-obsessed, technically fluent, and thrives in fast-moving startup environments. If you love the challenge of translating AI workflows into intuitive product experiences in a high-stakes industry, we want to talk to you.

Customer Engineering & Implementation

  • Configure Atrix templates, pipelines, and AI workflows to match complex scientific and medical processes

  • Set up and validate customer-approved data sources

  • Ensure accuracy, reliability, and trust in AI-generated outputs

  • Drive the full implementation lifecycle: onboarding → configuration → validation → go-live → iteration

  • Lead weekly customer calls and serve as the primary technical point of contact

Rapid Prototyping & Product Co-Creation

  • Build quick prototypes and workflow experiments for GTM initiatives

  • Translate customer needs into clear product requirements

  • Triage bugs, uncover feature gaps, and partner with engineering to implement fixes or enhancements

  • Shape product roadmap with insights drawn from real-world usage

Quality, Guardrails, & Accuracy

  • Own business-sense QA and accuracy validation for customer deployments

  • Identify risk, propose guardrails, and define scalable validation processes

  • Enable AI evals to ensure high trust and quality of all workflows

  • Create internal SOPs for deployment, QA, template configuration, and customer onboarding

Account Ownership & Expansion

  • Own 3–5 enterprise accounts end-to-end within 6 months

  • Identify patterns across accounts and surface scalable templates or product opportunities

  • Become a trusted technical advisor to medical, clinical, and commercial stakeholders

Must haves

  • 2–5 years in forward deployed engineering, software engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, ML implementation, data engineering, or adjacent roles

  • CS degree is required if non-software engineering role held in past.

  • Strong Python experience; comfortable doing light FE work in React/TS

  • Ability to write evals and optimize Ai-driven workflows.

  • Ability to translate complex technical ideas to a smart, non-technical scientific audience

  • Experience working with LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI-native tools (e.g., Claude code, Cursor)

  • Obsession with accuracy, reliability, and the details that matter in high-stakes workflows

  • Thrives in customer-facing environments and enjoys owning outcomes, not just tasks

  • Startup experience strongly preferred

Nice to haves

  • Background in life sciences, healthcare, or real-world data

  • Data science experience

  • Work experience at healthcare AI startups or technical consulting firms

  • Experience deploying AI in regulated or enterprise settings


Why Join Atrix as an FDE?

🚀 Mission-Driven Impact
Your work will help life sciences teams deliver the right treatment to the right patient—faster. Real-world clinical outcomes start with better tools, and you’ll be building them.

👨‍⚕️ Customer-Centric & High-Stakes
You won’t be building in a vacuum. You'll work directly with top-10 pharma companies to understand how AI can transform medical workflows—this is high-impact, high-visibility work.

🧱 End-to-End Ownership
Own major parts of the stack, shape technical architecture, and influence product direction from day one.

🌱 Early Stage, High Growth
We're small and moving fast. You’ll help shape both the technology and the culture as we scale.

🧠 Tech Meets Trust
Design AI-native workflows that scientific and medical teams trust and depend on daily.

📈 Clear Growth Path
Opportunity to grow into a Lead Frontend or Fullstack Tech Lead role as we expand the engineering team.

What we offer


💪 Health & wellness support – Stipend + medical (vision, dental, health) insurance coverage
🌴 Unlimited PTO – Recharge when you need to



Communication Test (est. time 5–10 min)

Instead of a traditional cover letter and resume, we’d like you to complete a short task to show how you work:

Step 1

Use an AI tool (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) to generate 3–5 short, fake customer interaction notes.
These should look like quick snippets from a customer support chat (e.g., a frustrated user, a neutral inquiry, a positive message).

Step 2

Using the same AI tool, create:

1. A simple checklist-style sentiment rubric

This should include:

  • The sentiment categories you choose (e.g., Positive, Neutral, Negative).

  • Short definitions for each category.

  • 1–2 criteria the evaluator/model should look for.

2. A short description (1–2 paragraphs) explaining:

  • How you used the AI tool.

  • What prompts you wrote.

  • Any challenges you encountered (e.g., model over-explaining, unclear sentiment boundaries).

Step 3

Send us your:

  • Customer interaction notes

  • Sentiment rubric (checklist)

  • LLM usage notes

These can be in a Google Doc, Word Doc, or PDF.

jobs.title: Founding Security Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Wexler

Wexler is building the best AI system for litigation on the planet. We work with some of the world’s largest law firms, helping them to solve their most complex cases, find the winning strategy in each matter, and create clarity from the chaos of documents and facts in each case. We are a rapidly growing, legal AI company based in London. Clifford Chance, HSFKramer, Goodwin, Addleshaw Goddard and more rely on us to help find the critical facts that can determine their chances of winning a case.

We’re backed with a $5.3M Seed by Pear VC, Seedcamp, The LegalTechFund + many leading industry angels.

We are building a comprehensive AI platform for managing, resolving and preventing legal disputes across Enterprise law firms and Fortune500 companies. We are growing 10x YoY and signing more eminent firms every month. Our system extracts, objective, cross referenced facts from millions of documents, helping litigators win more cases whilst saving months of working hours. In this way we ensure every client gets the representation they deserve.

AI is transforming the law, but most tools have focused on contract law or are generalist copilots that aggregate the tasks lawyers do across practices. Wexler is the leading gen-AI platform specifically built for the nuances of litigation, and our growth proves the story is resonating.

About the Role

As our first dedicated security hire, you’ll shape and own the foundation of Wexler’s security program — spanning infrastructure, product, and compliance. You’ll work closely with engineering, operations, and leadership to ensure we’re not only secure, but demonstrably so to our customers.

Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of existing security tooling and implement new ones (e.g. endpoint protection, MDM, access controls), ensuring they’re effectively configured, maintained, and scaled as the business grows

  • Embed secure-by-design practices into the development lifecycle — from secure coding and threat modelling to design reviews and CI/CD hardening

  • Monitor systems for irregular behaviour and proactively design detection and prevention mechanisms

  • Ensure infrastructure and applications align with accepted industry standards (e.g. OWASP Top 10, AWS Well-Architected Framework)

  • Conduct and lead risk assessments, including third-party/vendor reviews and internal evaluations

  • Document and maintain security policies, procedures, and controls as part of our ISO 27001-certified ISMS

  • Partner with GTM and leadership to demonstrate our security posture and compliance maturity to customers and prospects — helping turn security into a commercial advantage

You’ll love this role if you:

  • Have hands-on experience deploying and managing security tooling (EDR, MDM, ZTNA, vulnerability scanners, etc.) and enjoy solving problems at the implementation level

  • Have worked within AWS’s security ecosystem and can comfortably navigate enterprise security tools across vendors

  • Have solid foundations in networking, systems, and cloud infrastructure, and can apply frameworks like OWASP and AWS Well-Architected to real-world scenarios

  • Have experience reviewing and improving product and infrastructure security, including secure SDLC practices (e.g. threat modelling, secure code review, CI/CD hardening)

  • Are familiar with compliance frameworks like ISO 27001 or SOC 2, and can translate technical controls into well-documented policies and audit-ready evidence

  • Enjoy automating repetitive security tasks (Python, PowerShell, Bash, or via APIs) to improve efficiency and reduce manual work

  • Think proactively about risk reduction — not just fixing bugs but designing processes and controls that uplift the overall security posture

  • Have a generalist mindset and thrive across infrastructure, product, and compliance domains

You won’t love this role if you:

  • Want to do only policy work or only implementation — this is a hands-on, full-spectrum security role

  • Prefer a slow pace or require perfect clarity before acting — we move fast and prioritise action

  • Feel uncomfortable owning outcomes — you’ll be accountable end-to-end for critical security initiatives

jobs.title: Account Executive (Mid-Market)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Account Executive (Mid-Market)

New York City · Full-time · In person

Compensation

$150,000–$225,000 annual on-target earnings (base salary + commission), plus meaningful equity.

 

About Frontdesk

Frontdesk is building AI workers that run customer operations across voice, text, email, and chat. We are starting with the property management industry.

Our AI handles real work across the customer journey, from answering inbound calls to following up with leads, coordinating workflows, and taking action across the systems businesses already use.

We're growing quickly and moving upmarket. Over the last year, the size of the contracts we've been closing has grown roughly 10x, with several opportunities now reaching six figures and beyond. You're joining at an ideal stage: we've established repeatability and early playbooks, but they're still young enough for you to meaningfully shape how we scale them.

 

About the Role

We're hiring a Mid-Market Account Executive to help build the next stage of our sales organization.

This is a true full-cycle role. You'll own prospecting, cold outreach, discovery, demos, follow-up, negotiation, and close.

You'll initially focus on mid-market customers, with most deals around $8K–$25K ACV. If you're consistently performing, you'll have the opportunity to move quickly into larger mid-market and enterprise accounts.

There are no territories. If you find a great account, go win it.

You'll have support from SDRs, marketing, founders, and the broader team, but you'll own your pipeline and your number.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Own your pipeline from first touch through signed contract.

  • Prospect aggressively through cold calls, email, referrals, events, and creative outbound.

  • Run discovery, product demonstrations, negotiations, and closing.

  • Sell directly to owners, operators, and executive stakeholders.

  • Multi-thread accounts and keep deals moving.

  • Consistently meet and exceed sales targets.

  • Bring customer feedback directly into Product and Engineering.

  • Help shape our messaging, sales process, hiring bar, and team culture.

  • Attend industry events and meet customers in person when it helps win.

     

Why Great Salespeople Should Join Frontdesk

  • You're joining an early sales team. You'll have a real influence on how the sales organization gets built.

  • No territories. Great accounts are there for you to go after.

  • Real ownership. We care about the outcome, not whether you followed a prescribed process.

  • Increasing deal sizes. Start by mastering $8K–$25K deals, then earn your way into increasingly large accounts.

  • Build the playbook. A lot of what our future sales team does will come from what you figure out now.

  • Sell something customers actually care about. AI is fundamentally changing how businesses handle customer operations, and we're still early in that transition.

 

Requirements

  • At least 3 years of professional sales experience, including a quota-carrying B2B software Account Executive role and a track record of meeting or exceeding quota.

  • Comfortable generating your own pipeline rather than relying entirely on inbound or SDRs.

  • Strong cold calling, discovery, demo, negotiation, and closing skills.

  • Competitive and highly accountable for your number.

  • Excellent follow-up and pipeline management.

  • Comfortable selling to both operators and executives.

  • Able to learn a technical product quickly.

  • Excited by an early-stage environment where the playbook is still being written.

  • Based in New York City and able to work in person from our NYC office.

Preferred: experience selling to property managers, multifamily operators, or real estate businesses; previous BDR/SDR experience; and experience at an early-stage or similarly sized technology company.

 

Why Join

You're joining early enough to actually shape the company.

This isn't a role where you'll inherit a territory, run someone else's playbook, and optimize around the edges. You'll help us figure out how Frontdesk sells, who we hire, how we compete, and what kind of sales culture we build.

If you're great, the scope will expand quickly.

Come help us build the sales organization you would have wanted to join.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Senior Product Engineer @ Kato

About the Job

Position: Senior Product Engineer (Full-Time)

Reporting to: CTO

Location: San Francisco (4 days/week in person)

Company Overview

Lenders spend over $24B every year hiring agents to perform manual, repetitive servicing work. Existing AI solutions try to automate this, but they treat regulatory guardrails as an afterthought - meaning they can’t guarantee compliance and can’t be trusted with critical servicing workflows.

Kato takes a different approach.

Regulations aren’t an afterthought - they’re the foundation. We start with a regulatory rules system and layer an AI decision engine on top of it. With this architecture, we’re building an AI-powered servicing platform that automates critical workflows across every channel with full compliance and best-in-class recoveries. Human teams are then free to focus only on the judgment-driven work that truly needs them.

We are starting today with a compliance first Voice AI agent that handles outbound and inbound loan servicing calls, and are already in production with major names in the fintech lending space like Bilt Rewards and Parafin.

Kato is founded by a team with deep operating expertise in financial services and software engineering:

  • Pratik Risbud (CEO/Co-Founder): Former Investment Banker at Goldman Sachs and led Credit/Operations at Brex

  • David Zhu (CTO/Co-Founder): Former Software Engineer at Google and Engineering Manager at Brex

Kato is backed by institutional capital from Pear VC and angel investors from top tech companies such as Brex, Bridge, and Square. We are looking for top talent to join our team and power our growth.

The Role

We're seeking a driven, high-impact Senior Product Engineer to work directly with customers to build impactful new products and improvements. As our second engineering hire, you'll have an unparalleled opportunity to shape our technical foundation and future.

You'll own mission-critical projects driving company success, initially focusing on onboarding new customers and augmenting our voice agent framework as new customer needs arise. The role spans our entire technical stack - from real-time voice processing to customer-facing dashboards, infrastructure scaling, and product expansion. There will be significant opportunities to define product direction, build out engineering best practices and technical standards, and rapidly grow your scope and career.

Reporting directly to the CTO, this full-time role includes significant equity ownership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead architecture and implementation of our real-time voice processing system

  • Design and build scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems

  • Optimize LLM integration for natural, compliance-aware conversations

  • Develop internal tools for voice agent monitoring and improvement

  • Build customer-facing dashboards and reporting systems

  • Partner with customers to translate requirements into technical solutions

  • Establish engineering best practices and technical standards

  • Drive technical decisions that shape product direction

Requirements

Must Have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field

  • 2-5 years of production software engineering experience

  • Strong background in API design

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP)

  • Excellent problem-solving and architectural thinking

  • Strong communication and organizational skills

  • "Owner's mindset" with bias for action

  • Lives and breathes product and code quality

  • Endless curiosity and learning drive

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with real-time audio processing or WebRTC

  • Background in Golang, TypeScript, or React

  • Experience with LLM integration and prompt engineering

  • DevOps and infrastructure automation experience

  • Fintech or financial systems background

Tech Stack

  • Backend: Golang, PostgreSQL,

  • Frontend: Next.js, TypeScript, React, TailwindCSS

  • Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker

  • AI/ML: Large Language Models, Speech To Text, Text To Speech

  • DevOps: GitHub Actions, Datadog

Why Join Us

  • Work with experienced founders who've built and scaled financial products for 9+ years

  • Work with a CTO with experience in all stages of engineering maturity from 0 to 1, mid-stage startups, all the way to large enterprise companies

  • Build something meaningful - this won’t be a 9-to-5. It will be intense, rewarding, and career-defining. You will own core customer relationships and parts of the technical stack from day one.

  • Shape the technical foundation of a product revolutionizing a $24BN market

  • Get unmatched career acceleration: you’ll be working directly with customers getting direct feedback and direction from customer needs.

  • Direct impact on product strategy and company direction

  • Work with cutting-edge technologies in AI, voice processing, and cloud infrastructure

  • Define engineering culture and practices from the ground up

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About NomadicML

Americans drive over 5 trillion miles a year, more than 500 billion of them recorded. Buried in that footage is the next frontier of machine intelligence. At NomadicML, we're building the platform that unlocks it.

Our Vision-Language Models (VLMs) act as the new "hydraulic mining" for video, transforming raw footage into structured intelligence that powers real-world autonomy and robotics. We partner with industry leaders across self-driving, robotics, and industrial automation, including Zoox, Qualcomm, Boston Dynamics, and Mitsubishi Electric, to mine insights from petabytes of data that were once unusable.

We've grown from zero to $508K ARR in five months at 90% gross margins, with $3M in contracted expansions. We're backed by Pear VC, BAG VC, and Scott Wu (CEO of Cognition), with angels from Google DeepMind, Microsoft, and OpenAI.

NomadicML was founded by Mustafa Bal and Varun Krishnan, who met at Harvard University while studying Computer Science. Our team has built mission-critical AI systems at Snowflake, Lyft, Microsoft, Amazon, and IBM Research, holds top-tier publications at conferences like CVPR, and moves with the speed and clarity of a startup obsessed with impact.

About the Role

We're looking for a UX/UI Designer with strong visual taste at NomadicML.

You'll be instrumental in shaping how the world's leading autonomous vehicle and robotics companies experience our spatial intelligence platform. This means translating complex technical capabilities into intuitive interfaces, crafting a visual identity that reflects the precision and sophistication of our technology, and ensuring our product messaging resonates from the very first touchpoint.

Designers at NomadicML have broad creative license and the freedom to create and lead new initiatives based on your best product judgment. We expect a versatile skillset and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes across a variety of contexts. If you're energized by rapidly iterating on everything from dense product workflows to polished landing pages, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

UX UI Design: Design the end-to-end user experience of NomadicML's digital platform: designing flows for video upload, edge case discovery, search, review tools, and data export. Translate complex spatial intelligence concepts into clear, intuitive interfaces that enterprise engineers love to use.

Website & Marketing: Design website landing pages, product demos, and marketing assets that communicate our capabilities to technical buyers. Work closely with marketing to bring campaigns to life across channels.

Prototyping & Iteration: Rapidly explore visual designs in Figma and translate them into web-native experiences. Test usability and functionality across platforms and web interfaces. Create interactive prototypes to test ideas and communicate vision to engineering.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with engineers to ship pixel-perfect implementations, making pragmatic trade-offs when necessary. Work with marketing to ensure brand coherence across all touchpoints.

Digital Design Systems: Think systematically to build and maintain a digital design system that scales with our product and ensures a cohesive experience as we grow.

Visual Identity: Lead and evolve NomadicML's visual identity. Establish and maintain visual guidelines that ensure consistency across product, web, marketing, and sales materials. Design software with an eye towards NomadicML’s unique design aesthetic.

Example Projects

  • Design the flow, layout, and feature hierarchy for our video analysis dashboard where engineers review thousands of AI-surfaced edge cases.

  • Create landing pages that communicate how NomadicML turns raw driving footage into training-ready spatial intelligence.

  • Develop visual frameworks for presenting complex multi-sensor data and temporal reasoning in an accessible way.

  • Redesign our onboarding experience to reduce time-to-value for new enterprise customers.

  • Lead a brand refresh that positions NomadicML as the definitive spatial intelligence layer for autonomy.

You Might Be a Fit If You Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering or related degree.

  • Proficiency in Figma and modern design tools; comfort with prototyping interactive experiences.

  • A strong portfolio that shows great visual taste and user-centered thinking across digital design, UI design, UX design, and web design.

  • A bias toward action. You ship work, gather feedback, and iterate quickly.

  • Excellent communication skills; you can articulate design rationale to engineers, marketers, and founders alike.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AI, autonomous vehicles, robotics, or other deep-tech domains.

  • History of entrepreneurial projects or early-stage startup experience.

  • Experience with A/B testing, growth-oriented design, or data-informed iteration.

Why NomadicML

This is a rare opportunity to be the design voice at a company building critical infrastructure for the autonomous future. You'll work directly with other engineers to shape a product used by the world's most ambitious robotics and AV teams. You'll have real impact and the chance to define how spatial intelligence looks and feels.

We're a small, fast-moving team that values craft, speed, and intellectual honesty. If you want to do the best design work of your career at the intersection of AI and physical systems, we'd love to hear from you.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering or related degree.

 - Proficiency in Figma and modern design tools; comfort with prototyping interactive experiences.

 - A strong portfolio that shows great visual taste and user-centered thinking across digital design, UI design, UX design, and web design.

 -  A bias toward action. You ship work, gather feedback, and iterate quickly.

 - Excellent communication skills; you can articulate design rationale to engineers, marketers, and founders alike.





NICE TO HAVE

 - Familiarity with AI, autonomous vehicles, robotics, or other deep-tech domains.

 - History of entrepreneurial projects or early-stage startup experience.

 - Experience with A/B testing, growth-oriented design, or data-informed iteration.




WHY NOMADICML

This is a rare opportunity to be the design voice at a company building critical infrastructure for the autonomous future. You'll work directly with other engineers to shape a product used by the world's most ambitious robotics and AV teams. You'll have real impact and the chance to define how spatial intelligence looks and feels.

We're a small, fast-moving team that values craft, speed, and intellectual honesty. If you want to do the best design work of your career at the intersection of AI and physical systems, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Product Engineering Lead - Andera
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Andera

Andera is building reliable AI agents for back-office financial work, starting with automating audits for the world’s largest public companies.

Audits have resisted automation for decades due to the scale and instability of the underlying data. Large companies generate hundreds of millions of tokens of financial data across massive spreadsheets with constantly changing formats. Even understanding a single document can take expert auditors six or more hours, and a typical audit involves many of them.

We’re building agents that can parse, interpret, and reason over data of this complexity—compressing gigabytes of messy financial information into representations that LLMs can work with reliably. The result is turning weeks of manual audit work into minutes of review.

This work requires long-horizon reasoning, robust data systems, and production-grade reliability—and it forms the foundation for automating some of the most complex financial workflows in the world.

Founding Team

Andera is built on the belief that this problem can only be solved by pairing elite auditors with elite engineers.

  • Engineering team: Alumni of MIT, Berkeley, and Waterloo, with experience at Jane Street, Stripe, Shopify, and Microsoft.

  • Audit team: Former #1 performers at Deloitte and leaders of national finance practices at Revolut.

The Role

We’re hiring a Product Engineering Lead to own the primary product experience used by professional auditors. You’ll be responsible for designing and building interfaces that surface large, complex financial datasets and make AI agent output understandable, auditable, and trustworthy.

This is a high-ownership role with direct impact on adoption, trust, and product quality.

What You’ll Work On

  • Designing and building intuitive workflows for reviewing complex financial data and AI agent output

  • Designing and translating Figma designs into polished, production-ready applications

  • Building a new platform from the ground up, and designing end-to-end features that span frontend, backend, and infrastructure

  • Working directly with auditors (in house and customers) to understand their workflows and pain points

  • Improving reliability, performance, and observability across the product

  • Collaborating closely with AI and systems engineers to integrate agent capabilities into the UI

  • Building the product team from the ground up

What We’re Looking For

Strong fullstack engineering skills with ownership mindset

  • You can design and ship features end to end

  • You understand how UI, backend, and data systems interact

Deep empathy for users in complex domains

  • You can work with auditors to uncover root problems

  • You can translate ambiguous feedback into clear product decisions

Strong product and design sense

  • You know what makes an interface intuitive and trustworthy

  • You can turn wireframes into clean, usable experiences

Comfort operating in high-complexity systems

  • Large datasets, asynchronous workflows, partial failures

Experience with or adjacent to our stack:

  • TypeScript, Python, Temporal, Docker, Terraform, AWS Fargate

Why Andera

  • Own the core product experience from day one

  • Build software used by some of the largest companies in the world

Work closely with world-class auditors and engineers
High ownership and impact as an early team member

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Founding SDR (Sales Development Representative)

Location: US (2540 N 1st Street, San Jose, CA)
Type: Full-time
Reports to: CEO (initially)

About Oodle.ai

Oodle’s mission is to build an iconic observability company! Oodle.ai is an AI-native observability platform for logs, metrics, and traces—debugged in plain English. Under the hood, it’s powered by a modern serverless, S3-native architecture that’s radically simpler and 3–5× cheaper than legacy observability stacks. It's a drop-in replacement for Grafana, Elastic, and Datadog with 1-click migration. Customers include unicorns, and public companies: Lookout, Zaggle, CureFit, and Fuel Labs.

The founders are serial entrepreneurs (ex-Rubrik, AWS, YC, and IIT Alumni) who have built world class teams over the last decade. They lived through observability pain points for 8+ years - both as a buyer at a high scale company for 4.5 years (Rubrik) and as a company builder selling to the same buyer (4+ years at YC Startup). Our team has built and launched world-class products like Rubrik Security Cloud, AWS S3, DynamoDB, and Snowhouse at Snowflake. The team has not only co-founded startups but also understands how to scale them. We are backed by Engineering Capital, Pear VC, and SNR VC (2025's best early stage investor).

We’re winning customers who are tired of:

  • Datadog cost blowups

  • Elastic/OpenSearch operational overhead

  • Grafana/Loki scaling ceilings

  • Slow incident resolution

The Role

We’re hiring a Founding SDR to build our outbound engine from scratch.

This is for someone who has done early-stage startup selling before (ideally infra/devtools), sells well to technical buyers, and brings real hunger + high energy.

What You’ll Do

  • Prospect into SRE, DevOps, Platform, Infra, VP Eng

  • Run high-volume outbound across email, LinkedIn, and calls

  • Book qualified meetings and generate real pipeline

  • Learn the product deeply and improve messaging weekly

  • Build sequences, talk tracks, and a repeatable SDR playbook

  • Partner directly with the CEO + founding team

What We’re Looking For

You’ll do well here if you have:

  • Early-stage startup experience (Seed/Series A)

  • Experience selling infra/devtools to technical buyers

  • Entrepreneurial (has desire to start a company one day)

  • Strong outbound fundamentals + high activity

  • High ownership, urgency, and consistency

  • Comfortable coming to office 5 days / week (occasional travel)

  • The ability to learn fast, iterate, and bounce back quickly

Who this role is NOT for

This role is not for someone who:

  • Expects to be told what to do every day

  • Needs a perfectly defined process before executing

  • Can’t handle ambiguity, change, or intensity

Who this role IS for

This role is for someone who is entrepreneurial and wants to help build a foundational company — the kind of platform that becomes an industry default. If you want to be part of creating something in the league of Snowflake, Databricks, Rubrik (category-defining infrastructure), you’ll thrive here.

What Success Looks Like (First 60–90 Days)

  • Consistent meetings/week with ICP-fit accounts

  • Strong outbound motion that improves weekly

  • Clear learnings on personas, industries, and messaging

  • A repeatable playbook we can scale with future hires

Compensation

  • Competitive base + uncapped commission

  • Meaningful equity (early team)

  • Path to AE / Founding GTM / SDR Lead as we scale

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Top tier health, medical, and dental benefits

  • Meaningful equity ownership

  • Stunning colleagues

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Frontend
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About NomadicML

Americans drive over 5 trillion miles a year, more than 500 billion of them recorded. Buried in that footage is the next frontier of machine intelligence. At NomadicML, we’re building the platform that unlocks it.

Our Vision-Language Models (VLMs) act as the new “hydraulic mining” for video, transforming raw footage into structured intelligence that powers real-world autonomy and robotics. We partner with industry leaders across self-driving, robotics, and industrial automation to mine insights from petabytes of data that were once unusable.

NomadicML was founded by Mustafa Bal and Varun Krishnan, who met at Harvard University while studying Computer Science.

  • Mustafa is a core contributor to ONNX Runtime and DeepSpeed with deep expertise in distributed systems and large-scale model training infrastructure

  • Varun is an INFORMS Wagner Prize Finalist for his research in large-scale driver navigation AI models and one of the top chess players in the US.

Our team has built mission-critical AI systems at Snowflake, Lyft, Microsoft, Amazon, and IBM Research, holds top-tier publications in VLMS and AI at conferences like CVPR, and moves with the speed and clarity of a startup obsessed with impact.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Frontend Engineer who can move extremely fast and turn ambitious designs into polished, production-ready interfaces.

This role sits at the intersection of design, product, and engineering. You’ll work closely with our founding designer and backend / ML teams to ship new product surfaces, workflows, and interactions at startup speed. You’ll be responsible for making sure everything looks right, feels right, and works flawlessly, from complex video review dashboards to high-impact landing pages.

The ideal candidate is deeply execution-oriented, comfortable using modern AI-powered dev tools to accelerate development, and excited to experiment, iterate, and ship. If you enjoy taking loosely defined ideas and rapidly turning them into beautiful, usable software, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Bring Designs to Life
Implement high-fidelity product and marketing designs with precision. Translate Figma files into responsive, accessible, and performant web experiences.

Move Fast With AI Tools
Leverage AI-assisted development tools to prototype, iterate, and ship frontend features quickly without sacrificing quality.

Product UI Development
Build and own major parts of NomadicML’s web application, including dashboards for video review, search, edge-case exploration, and customer workflows.

Design-Engineering Collaboration
Work hand-in-hand with the founding designer to explore new interaction patterns, refine visual details, and push the product’s look and feel forward.

Quality & Reliability
Ensure frontend experiences are robust, intuitive, and bug-free. You’ll care deeply about correctness, polish, and performance.

Iteration & Experimentation
Rapidly test new UI ideas, animations, and layouts. Kill what doesn’t work, double down on what does.

Frontend Architecture
Help shape our frontend stack and best practices so we can scale the product without slowing down.

You Might Be a Fit If You Have

  • A strong frontend portfolio showcasing real, shipped work (product UIs, dashboards, complex web apps, or high-quality websites)

  • Deep experience with React and modern frontend frameworks (Next.js preferred)

  • Strong command of TypeScript, HTML, and CSS

  • A track record of shipping quickly in fast-moving environments

  • Comfort working from design tools like Figma and collaborating closely with designers

  • An eye for detail: spacing, typography, animations, and interaction polish matter to you

  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate development and experimentation

  • Clear communication skills and a bias toward action

Nice to Have

  • Experience with data-heavy or visualization-rich interfaces

  • Familiarity with Tailwind, Framer Motion, or similar UI/animation libraries

  • Experience building internal tools or B2B / developer-facing products

  • Interest in AI, robotics, autonomous vehicles, or other deep-tech domains

  • Startup or early-stage company experience

Why NomadicML

This is a rare opportunity to help define the frontend of a company building visual AI for autonomy and robotics. You’ll have real ownership, real influence, and the freedom to move fast.

We value craft, speed, and judgment. You’ll work directly with founders, designers, and engineers who care deeply about building something exceptional. If you want to ship ambitious frontend work at the edge of AI and physical systems, and do it fast, we’d love to talk.

jobs.title: Founding Full-Stack Engineer - Takt
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Takt

Our Vision: A world where factories think.

Takt is building the brains of factories.

Factories have spent the last decade digitizing: adding sensors, software, and

dashboards everywhere. Yet most factories aren’t meaningfully smarter. Data is

fragmented across disconnected systems, locked in reports, and dependent on tribal

knowledge living in people’s heads.

The hard problem isn’t collecting data, it’s turning it into institutional intelligence.

Takt is building the brains of factories. We’re closing the loop from data → information

→ insight → action by orchestrating AI agents with deep operational context across

the entire manufacturing stack. These systems reason about what’s happening, why it’s

happening, and what to do next, acting as a continuous thought partner to factory

leadership across sales, operations, supply chain, and finance.

This is not a chatbot or another analytics layer. We’re pushing the frontier of AI

reasoning and decision-making in real-world, high-stakes environments. Just as Tesla

redefined the car as a software-first system, Takt is redefining manufacturing as a

software-defined industry.

Funding

Takt is funded by Pear VC (backed Doordash, Gusto) and is part of the

PearX accelerator program.

Website: www.taktconnect.com

Founders

Takt was founded by Adhitya Raghavan (CEO) and Will Zunker (CTO).

Adhitya is from a small village in South India and first learned about factories by working

as an operator on his father’s shop floor. His journey through squash took him to

Princeton (Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering), Harvard (MBA, Baker Scholar), and

Bain. Now, he’s bringing it full circle, building Takt to solve the very pain he experienced

firsthand in factories and aiming to put a dent in the $8 trillion of waste that occurs in

manufacturing globally.

Will an MIT PhD has deep experience in optimizing manufacturing processes through

physics-based modeling and AI, driven by a belief that advanced methods can

fundamentally transform how things are made. Along the way, he built open-source

tools and collaborated with engineers across diverse manufacturing sectors, learning

firsthand the challenges of waste and inefficiency on the factory floor. Now, at Takt, he’s

channeling that journey into building technology that helps factories run smarter, faster,

and with less waste.

Core Cultural Values

  1. Stupid enough to make our dreams a reality: We are dreamers who build a better world. We own our decisions. We have the irrational belief and hunger to work until our dreams are a reality

  2. The last one standing: Every single person takes ownership of their work with a gritty resourcefulness and dares to fight for it with every ounce of their energy.

  3. Insatiable curiosity: Its always day 1 and we are an empty cup, a dry sponge ready to learn. Approaching every action with humility and scientific rigor and adopting a Kaizen mindset.

  4. The best F1 team in the stadium: We win together and lose together; every person plays a crucial role to win the race. We have high expectations, trust our teammates and create the environment for everyone to shine. In the path the victory, we celebrate every small professional and personal win cherishing the journey

Role

Founding Full Stack Engineer

  • Location: San Francisco, in person 4 to 5 days a week. Open to candidates willing to relocate.

  • Hours: 50 to 70 hours per week with space for personal interests

  • Compensation: 120-180K

  • Equity: To be discussed (0.5-1%)

  • Prior experience: 2-3 years minimum

You will be the first engineering hire and will work directly with the founders to build the

core intelligence engine that powers modern factories. You will help design, build, and

deploy systems across the entire stack and influence the earliest product, infrastructure,

and architecture decisions. This role is for someone who wants deep ownership and

real long-term impact.

Core Technical Requirements

  • Experience deploying and maintain full stack production grade code at scale to support 50-100 enterprise customers with minimal downtime

  • Strong cloud infrastructure skills (Azure preferred).

  • Deep experience with data pipelines, especially cleaning messy, inconsistent real-world data AI-native in approach to coding utilizing new-age tools (e.g. Claude Code) to develop with speed.

  • Strong generalist coding skillset especially on the back-end side.

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping production AI/ML or LLM systems end-to-end (not research prototypes).

  • Comfortable owning LLM tool orchestration, chain design, agent delegation, prompt engineering, and evaluation methodology.

  • Hands-on experience integrating with enterprise systems like ERP, MES, and other data historians (Microsoft Business Central/ SAP)

  • Working knowledge of relational + SQL databases

  • Familiarity with per missioning models, data governance, or SOC2/GDPR.

  • Experience engaging with IT teams and meeting security requirements for enterprise customers.

Mindset & Work Style

  • Strong sense of agency and ownership: comfortable making fast decisions and revising them.

  • Shipping and moving quickly, makes practical choices, and delivers value to customers

  • Willing to learn and can get things done, even if they don’t know it from the get-go

  • Thrives with incomplete information

  • Passion for the product: speaks their mind, contributes ideas, and pushes for the best solution

  • Long-term commitment to the mission, we are building foundational systems, not short-lived features. This means putting in the hours consistently and also making harder short term decisions for long term benefits

 3. Insatiable curiosity: Its always day 1 and we are an empty cup, a dry sponge ready to learn. Approaching every action with humility and scientific rigor and adopting a Kaizen mindset.

 4. The best F1 team in the stadium: We win together and lose together; every person plays a crucial role to win the race. We have high expectations, trust our teammates and create the environment for everyone to shine. In the path the victory, we celebrate every small professional and personal win cherishing the journey




ROLE

Founding Full Stack Engineer

 - Location: San Francisco, in person 4 to 5 days a week. Open to candidates willing to relocate.

 - Hours: 50 to 70 hours per week with space for personal interests

 - Compensation: 120-180K

 - Equity: To be discussed (0.5-1%)

 - Prior experience: 2-3 years minimum



You will be the first engineering hire and will work directly with the founders to build the

core intelligence engine that powers modern factories. You will help design, build, and

deploy systems across the entire stack and influence the earliest product, infrastructure,

and architecture decisions. This role is for someone who wants deep ownership and

real long-term impact.




CORE TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

 - Experience deploying and maintain full stack production grade code at scale to support 50-100 enterprise customers with minimal downtime

 - Strong cloud infrastructure skills (Azure preferred).

 - Deep experience with data pipelines, especially cleaning messy, inconsistent real-world data AI-native in approach to coding utilizing new-age tools (e.g. Claude Code) to develop with speed.

 - Strong generalist coding skillset especially on the back-end side.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience shipping production AI/ML or LLM systems end-to-end (not research prototypes).

 - Comfortable owning LLM tool orchestration, chain design, agent delegation, prompt engineering, and evaluation methodology.

 - Hands-on experience integrating with enterprise systems like ERP, MES, and other data historians (Microsoft Business Central/ SAP)

 - Working knowledge of relational + SQL databases

 - Familiarity with per missioning models, data governance, or SOC2/GDPR.

 - Experience engaging with IT teams and meeting security requirements for enterprise customers.


MINDSET & WORK STYLE

 - Strong sense of agency and ownership: comfortable making fast decisions and revising them.

 - Shipping and moving quickly, makes practical choices, and delivers value to customers

 - Willing to learn and can get things done, even if they don’t know it from the get-go

 - Thrives with incomplete information

 - Passion for the product: speaks their mind, contributes ideas, and pushes for the best solution

 - Long-term commitment to the mission, we are building foundational systems, not short-lived features. This means putting in the hours consistently and also making harder short term decisions for long term benefits

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager - freeflow
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Freeflow

Freeflow is building AI Agents for P&C Insurance Carriers.

We’re starting by solving a customer problem that has strong pull from our industry contacts: Claims auditing.

Today, carriers audit a small percentage of claims. They do these audits manually, inconsistently, and often too late to drive meaningful outcomes on key business metrics like Loss Ratio, Customer Satisfaction, or Claims Capacity.

We believe the future is:

→ Continuous, AI-driven audits across 100% of claims → Real-time detection of leakage, errors, and missed opportunities → Direct, measurable improvement to the loss ratio

But claims audits are just the starting point.

Our broader vision is to build an AI-native operating layer for insurance carriers, that includes:

  • Submission intake: structuring and routing risk data at the quote stage

  • Premium audits: ensuring accuracy between exposure and written premium at the bind stage

  • Claims audits: real-time detection of leakage, errors, and missed opportunities at the claim stage

Having even two out of the three nodes allows Freeflow to create an intelligent data layer powered by AI agents that continuously improves decision-making across the carrier’s operations.

This is how we move the loss ratio at scale.

As a Founding Product Manager at freeflow you will

  • You will work directly with founders, customers, and engineers to define what we build, why we build it, and how it creates real economic value (eg improving loss ratios, replacing offshore teams, improving capacity, etc)

  • This is a 0→1 role where you will define how AI agents:

    • Understand the world of insurance through modeling industry ontologies

    • Understand and integrate with our various carrier customers’ systems and SOPs

    • Review specific data structures (claims files, policies, submissions)

    • Generate actionable intelligence based on core data to create both efficiency gains and learning opportunities for our carrier customers

  • Work directly with carriers

    • Engage claims leaders, audit teams, and executives

    • Translate real-world pain into shipped product quickly

About You

  • Technical

    • Leverage yourself and the product org with AI

    • Interviewing users, SMEs and documenting + transmitting learnings across org

    • Modeling requirements

    • Prioritizing efforts in alignment with business strategy

    • Managing backlogs, feature prioritization

    • Close collaboration with product design

    • Given the carrier customers (SOC2, RBAC, SSO, data partitioning), understand enterprise security and compliance requirements.

    • Collaborate on product strategy, roadmap prioritization, and go-to-market decisions.

    • Partner directly with engineers to break down product requirements into actionable specs. You'll own the "what" and "why," collaborate on the "how," and be close enough to implementation details to unblock decisions quickly.

  • Cultural

    • Passionate about solving customer needs and love moving fast. You are excited about the opportunity to be the primary AI/agent specialist on a small, high-ownership engineering team

    • You can demonstrate experience with solving open-ended problems in startups at the earliest stage (0 to 1) and you are

      • able to independently identify critical problems to deliver on key customer needs, propose and implement solutions to those problems

      • able to structure and execute your own work with little to no supervision

Bonus

  • Deep experience in P&C insurance claims or claims auditing

  • Comfort working large unstructured data files (documents, notes, images, video, audio, tasks)

Note, we don’t expect you to know everything listed above. What matters most to us is that you are experienced, enjoy solving hard problems independently, are passionate about building new AI technology, are an outstanding team player, and you are interested in learning and growing on the job professionally and personally.

If you’re excited about building AI systems that start with claims audits, but expand into a broader platform that transforms how insurance carriers operate:

We should talk.

What We Offer

  • Role

    • Being part of a mission-driven company reimagining how humans interact with technology.

    • A well defined culture that values autonomy, experimentation, growth and high impact results.

  • Benefits

    • Competitive compensation, stock options, health insurance

    • Flexible PTO

    • AI tooling + add-ons of your choice to maximize your productivity

jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Companies have spent billions on AI tools and tokens. Almost none of them can prove it’s working. 95% of organizations report zero measurable return from their AI investments. Not because the tools are bad, but because nobody redesigned the workflows, coached the teams, or measured what actually changed.

Modo is the AI success layer for the enterprise. We sit inside the flow of work, capture how teams actually use AI, guide them in the moment, and give leaders the ROI analytics to understand which AI tools and workflows are actually creating value.

Today, Modo helps companies drive AI adoption and prove ROI inside real workflows. As we capture more workflow context, Modo becomes the layer understanding how work actually gets done across teams, tools, and AI, which allows companies to build proprietary custom agents grounded in their own workflows.

We are a Seed stage startup, raised from One Way Ventures, Pear VC, Peterson Ventures, JFF Ventures, and a strong group of institutional investors and strategic operators. Now we need to build fast enough to match customer demand.

The Role

This is not a typical engineering role. You’ll be our founding engineer, with an outsized role in how the product, company, and engineering culture evolve.

You’ll write code, but you’ll also:

  • Talk to customers and join pilot calls

  • Turn feedback into product changes the same week

  • Influence the roadmap directly

  • Help close deals by building what matters fast

  • Own features end-to-end, from prototype to production

In your first 90 days, you’ll:

  • Ship production code to real pilot customers in your first weeks

  • Build the core product surfaces: employee-facing guidance UX and manager dashboard

  • Work across the stack (TypeScript, React, Next.js, Postgres, Electron/Tauri)

  • Wire up LLM features that actually work in production, not just in a demo

  • Set up the telemetry and eval systems that make our insights credible

In 6 months, you’ll:

  • Own large product surface areas end-to-end

  • Help convert pilots into paying contracts with your product work

  • Drive the reliability and quality bar that enterprise buyers expect

  • Start shaping engineering culture and hiring as we grow the team

In 12 months, you’ll:

  • Architect key parts of the system

  • Be known by name to our biggest customers

  • Opportunity to lead engineering as we scale past our seed round

Competitive salary, meaningful early equity, and the chance to grow into an engineering leadership role as we scale.

Who We Want

  • Shipping full-stack production-ready products in fast-moving environments

  • Strong with TypeScript, React, Next.js, backend APIs, and Postgres

  • Comfortable building across web and desktop (Electron, Tauri, or similar)

  • Has built LLM-powered features in production, not just prototyped with them

  • Production habits: CI/CD, testing, observability, pragmatic system design

  • Native with AI coding agents (Claude Code/Codex)

  • Obsessive about customer needs, not just abstract “users”

  • Comfortable debugging, writing tests, talking to customers, and jumping on a pilot call

Bonus: Experience with building browser-based automation tools or developer/enterprise tools.

The Team

You’ll join Johnny Chang (Stanford top AI agent research, taught most Stanford AI flagship courses with professors like Andrew Ng) and Angelina You (Meta data science, Stanford MS Eng, product growth at CircleCI) as the founding engineer. Product, engineering, and customer work all run through the same room.

We’re backed by One Way Ventures, Pear VC, Peterson Ventures, JFF Ventures, and many more institutional funds and strategic angels.

Why Modo

  • Founding team member. Shape culture, product, and technology from the ground up.

  • Real ownership. Your code ships to enterprise customers from week one.

  • Leadership trajectory. Designed to grow into a leading engineering role.

  • In-person around SF. We believe great teams build faster together.

  • Competitive pay + early equity. Rewarded for the outsized impact you’ll have.

How to Apply

Email johnny@joinmodo.com with:

  • Your GitHub

  • Your Resume

  • 2 to 3 links to things you’ve shipped (projects, products, demos, write-ups)

  • A short note on the most impressive thing you’ve built

jobs.title: Founding CSM - Endless Commerce
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Endless Commerce

Endless Commerce is an AI-powered CommerceOS that helps consumer brands manage the chaos of omnichannel operations. We serve brands scaling from $1M to $500M+ in revenue, providing real-time inventory visibility, EDI and purchase order automation, and supply chain intelligence across DTC, wholesale, marketplaces, and retail channels.

Our clients include brands like Food52, Great Jones, Heyday, Tin Can, Pattern Brands and more-- we're growing fast and our nimble team needs your help keeping up!

The Role

You're a relationship-driven operator who thrives on making customers wildly successful. As our first CSM, you'll own the entire post-sale experience— from onboarding new brands to deepening relationships with our existing portfolio, identifying expansion opportunities, and building the playbooks that will define how Endless Commerce delivers value at scale. This role is great for someone who loves wearing many hats and finds genuine satisfaction in solving real operational problems for the brands they work with. Expect to own onboarding, retention, expansion, and everything in between.

What You'll Own

  • Onboarding: Lead new customers from signed contract to fully live on Endless— coordinating with our product team to ensure a smooth, fast, and confidence-building launch experience.

  • Retention & renewals: Own the health of your book of business. Build strong relationships with key stakeholders at each brand, proactively identify risk, and drive renewals.

  • Expansion revenue: Deeply understand each customer's operations so you can identify where additional Endless Commerce capabilities— new channels, features, or integrations— can make their lives easier and grow our footprint.

  • Customer comms: Partner with product and marketing to keep customers informed on product updates, new capabilities, and growth opportunities that are relevant to their business.

  • Playbook building: As our founding CSM, you'll be creating things from scratch— onboarding checklists, QBR templates, health score frameworks, escalation processes. You'll set the standard for how we do CS.

  • Voice of the customer: Synthesize feedback from across your portfolio and bring it back to product and leadership to help us build a better platform.

  • Customer referrals: Work hand-in-hand with our partnerships and marketing efforts to turn happy customers into advocates who refer new brands into our ecosystem.

You're a Great Fit If

  • You have 3–5+ years of customer success or account management experience, ideally in a SaaS environment serving e-commerce or consumer brands

  • You’re directionally interested in taking what you learn about our customers’ needs, wants, and desires and helping turn those into tangible product features

  • You understand the operational chaos that omnichannel brands face and can speak credibly about inventory, orders, wholesale, and retail

  • You're highly organized and data-driven, but also a creative problem-solver who can think on your feet

  • High EQ and customer (and team) sensitivity

  • You're comfortable being hands-on— this isn't a purely strategic role; you'll be in the weeds of onboarding, troubleshooting, and building from scratch

  • You can work cross-functionally with our tiny and nimble sales, marketing, and product teams to ensure customers always feel supported

Logistics

  • Full-time, remote position

  • Full benefits package including healthcare and 401k

jobs.title: Founding Engineer - Elo
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Elo is the ad-network for consumer AI applications. We’ve gone from 0 to XXM users in our publisher network in 45 days of inception.

Background

With AI becoming the primary surface of interaction for internet users, it is inevitable that digital advertising will happen within AI experiences (including but not limited to chat).

Elo is aggregating supply across consumer AI apps to help them monetize their users via ads and help advertisers reach the right audience at the right moment.

We’re backed by top funds like PearVC and Audacious Ventures who’ve invested in billion dollar companies like Doordash and WorkOS. We also have advisors from mobile ad-tech and large consumer AI companies helping us in our mission. Founder is a published researcher and has previously built AI infrastructure at Google.

Progress
We’ve already solved the hardest cold start problem with ad networks: onboarding both advertisers and publishers. Now, we need to build and improve the core infrastructure to serve the most contextually relevant ads at the right moment.

Role
Founding engineer who’ll help us design the engine for ad delivery inside AI experiences and supporting infrastructure. The role guarantees high equity and competitive compensation

What you’ll build

We’re already processing millions of requests per minute which is set to increase dramatically over the next few months.


You’ll work on:

  1. Ad decisioning pipeline: candidate retrieval, scoring, filtering, and final ranking under strict latency SLAs

  2. Publisher SDK: lightweight integration that AI app developers embed in hours, not days

  3. Delivery infrastructure: pacing, frequency capping, budget management, and campaign throttling

  4. Observability stack: real-time dashboards for auction win rates, fill rates, revenue, and latency percentiles

What we’re looking for

We look for evidence of technical excellence.

If you’ve built any of the following, we’d love to chat:

  1. Your own AI agent harness or multi-agent workflow for complex tasks

  2. Low latency network infrastructure and data pipelines serving millions of requests per second

  3. Scalable and self-healing infrastructure with 1000s of compute workers spinning up and down with variable demand

  4. High frequency trading systems

Or anything that you believe reflects high calibre of engineering design and low-level systems understanding.

You’re a good fit if you:

  1. Care about your craft and operate ethically

  2. Take extreme ownership of outcomes

  3. Like to operate independently

  4. Ship extremely fast and effectively use AI to accelerate your impact

  5. Want to operate in a fun and social work environment

Apply and you’ll hear back in less than a day.

jobs.title: Founding Software Engineer - TruTec
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Founding Software Engineer - TruTec

About TruTec

TruTec is an AI-powered construction takeoff platform that is revolutionizing a $17 billion industry. We automate the tedious, manual process of site measurement and material estimation—turning hours or days of work into seconds. By leveraging satellite imagery, drone photos, and uploaded plans, we provide contractors with instant, bid-ready reports and invoicing tools.

We are currently at the pre-seed stage and growing rapidly, with new customers joining daily. To keep up with this demand and continue expanding our product, we are looking for a Founding Software Engineer to join our team.

The Role

As a Founding Engineer, you will have a direct impact on TruTec’s trajectory. You won't just be writing code; you'll be building the foundation of a product that automates the job of a construction estimator.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ship Independently: Take ownership of features from conception to deployment.

  • Performance Optimization: Work on making the platform significantly faster and more responsive.

  • Cross-Platform Delivery: Ensure the experience is lightweight and highly functional on Windows devices.

  • Scale the Product: Help us expand our capabilities to stay ahead of the competition and meet the needs of our rapidly growing customer base.

Who You Are

  • Builder Mentality: You have a track record of shipping products—whether through high-impact internships or your own independent projects.

  • Technical Excellence: You likely have a background from a top-tier (T1) undergraduate program.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Engineer - Spur
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Customer Success Engineer

Spur builds fundamental technology for the future of QA: autonomous browser agents that think, explore, validate, and self-heal like real users. We’re not another test tool — we’re reimagining how digital teams ship with confidence.

The market has responded loudly. Top brands (Alo Yoga, Living Spaces, HelloFresh, Nextdoor, Abercrombie & Fitch, and more) are actively pulling us in. Inbound demand is exploding. Sales cycles are fast. And the product actually delivers — teams go live in days, not months.

We’re a small, elite team of builders from DeepMind, Figma, ex-founders and customers — shipping at a pace that big companies can’t touch.

Our Mission: We want to help our customers deliver the best digital experiences
Read our Manifesto: https://www.spurtest.com/manifesto

Interview Process: https://fuzzy-gate-f84.notion.site/How-We-Hire-Customer-Success-Engineer-339ae376ae678197be0ad32f9467d580?pvs=74

About the Role

We’re looking for a Technical Customer Success Engineer to help our customers succeed with AI-driven testing in real production environments. This is a hands-on, technical role for someone with a Technical background who wants to work closely with customers, obsess over metrics and drive product growth.

You’ll start by shadowing experienced Solution Engineers, working closely with our Account Executives, and gradually take ownership of customers, pilots, and test strategies.

If you enjoy solving real-world problems, love direct customer interaction, and are excited to learn fast, this role is designed to grow with you.

What You’ll Do

  • Work directly with customers to help them adopt and succeed with Spur’s AI-driven testing platform

  • Author, maintain, and improve AI-powered test flows for customer applications

  • Debug failed tests and investigate AI agent behaviors in customer environments

  • Support pilots and production usage by improving test reliability and coverage

  • Monitor and track customer activity, engagement and relay product feedback to design and engineering teams

  • Translate customer intent into effective prompts and workflows

  • Partner with Account Executives during onboarding, demos, and spurring sessions

  • Provide clear technical explanations to both technical and non-technical users

  • Feed real-world learnings back into product and engineering to drive platform improvement

  • Gradually take full ownership of customer accounts and lead technical conversations

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Work at the intersection of AI, QA/test automation, and customer-facing engineering

  • Shape how AI agents behave in production by designing, debugging, and optimizing tests

  • Not a static role: you’ll go far beyond supporting software and play a direct part in shaping customer outcomes

  • Early and deep exposure to both prompt engineering and real-world use cases

What Success Looks Like

  • First 3 months: Shadow Solution Engineers, write and debug tests, support customer pilots, and develop deep understanding of Spur

  • By 6 months: Independently own customer pilots or accounts, improve coverage and reliability, debug complex issues, and suggest workflow enhancements

  • By 9–12 months: Operate as a Solution Engineer, lead technical conversations, own customer test strategy, and influence product and AI behavior through customer feedback

What We’re Looking For

We value mindset and fundamentals over perfect resumes.

Must Have:

  • 3–4 years experience in Customer Success Roles

  • Comfort with Technical Concepts

  • Customer Obsession & Being able to handle multiple accounts and context switch

  • Strong understanding of web applications and browser behavior

  • Clear communication skills and empathy for customers

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn new tools, processes, and AI concepts

  • AI Comfort - We are an AI first company and use AI in every aspect of our workflow and GTM team

Nice to Have:

  • Automation experience with any framework

  • QA / Testing Experience

  • Basic scripting knowledge or eagerness to learn

  • Exposure to CI/CD or API testing

  • Interest in AI, LLMs, or prompt engineering

You don’t need to be an AI expert—you need an appetite to learn and help customers thrive.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Equity package

  • Benefits offering (Gym & Wellness Stipends, Meal Stipends, OffSites)

  • In-person role based in our NYC office

Spur is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other protected status.
